#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input_str;
    std::getline(std::cin, input_str);
    std::string content = input_str.substr(1, input_str.size() - 2);
    int length_content = content.size();
    std::string output_str;
    output_str += input_str[0];
    int position = 0;
    bool at_found = false;
    while (position < length_content) {
        if (position + 3 <= length_content) {
            if (content.substr(position, 3) == "dot") {
                output_str += ".";
                position += 3;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (position + 2 <= length_content && !at_found) {
            if (content.substr(position, 2) == "at") {
                output_str += "@";
                at_found = true;
                position += 2;
                continue;
            }
        }
        output_str += content[position];
        position += 1;
    }
    output_str += input_str.back();
    std::cout << output_str << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
